evidence: A user calls SUB/WAVE great but notes that recommendations are limited to their existing music collection and wishes for streaming-service integration.

evidence_sources.author: pbnjay
evidence_sources.excerpt: I've been using https://www.getsubwave.com lately and it's great, but it is unfortunately already pre-filtered to my music collection. Would be slick to connect to spotify or a streaming service though!

source_story_title: I wish tech companies knew more about me
